decisions.title: Metafield capability and storefront rendering boundary
decisions.context: Broad owner/type support must not imply Liquid access or unsafe public exposure.
alternatives: Versioned capability registry with staging probes and typed Liquid renderers
decisions.decision: Propose registry-driven Admin capabilities and contextual theme app blocks; retain existing stack.

decisions.title: Standard templates and existing custom namespace
decisions.context: The app currently creates custom definitions in vsn_metafields. Standard definitions have Shopify template IDs and reserved namespace/key; existing merchant values must not be rewritten or deleted by a new catalog.
alternatives: Treat standards as ordinary custom definitions in vsn_metafields
Enable official standard templates separately and retain existing custom definitions in place
decisions.decision: Propose separate standard-template enable flow and custom-definition flow. Preserve vsn_metafields in place. Any namespace migration needs an inventory, per-shop conflict report, value mapping, opt-in/rollback plan and staging evidence before approval.
consequences: No silent migration or duplicate standard key
Custom namespace remains visible until a later approved migration
security_privacy_data_operational_cost_i: Definition deletion and value migration can lose or orphan data
Owner scopes and storefront access must be verified for each enabled template

decisions.title: Theme block source and presentation configuration
decisions.context: Merchants need extensive block customization, while Liquid context, dynamic source compatibility and safe storefront access vary by template and type.
alternatives: A universal block with arbitrary namespace/key and raw value output
Contextual typed blocks using compatible dynamic sources and bounded presentation controls
decisions.decision: Propose contextual Single Field and Specifications blocks with typed renderers, native dynamic sources when compatible, bounded controls and explicit empty states. Defer any external block configuration service until theme schema limits are verified in two themes.
consequences: Theme compatibility and per-type renderer work required
security_privacy_data_operational_cost_i: Never expose Admin tokens or protected owner values to Liquid
Bound list and reference rendering, escape output and verify accessibility/performance

rules: Accepted material decisions must not be silently reversed.
A replacement decision must preserve supersession traceability.
Decision evidence must distinguish verified facts from inference.
